rationale: Build on the current best recurrent-tail family instead of another loss or export rewrite. The strongest nearby local miss was a capped reverse-tail recurrence profile, so this keeps the staged curriculum but adds a late ramped cap on non-final recurrent passes to preserve the final reverse-tail block while reducing over-recursion in the earlier recurrent block near the quantized endgame. The change is compact, compile-stable, keeps eval/export untouched, and stays under the line budget.
title: Capped Staged Reverse-Tail Recurrence
